title: Fewer monsters, steadier music
text:
Fewer monsters in the open world, a fix for the tavern music, a character screen without a scroll bar and website updates.

• Fewer monsters: the open world now has a third fewer monsters, and the crabs, drowned sailors and Tidecallers of Mirrowmere are spread along the whole shore instead of crowding one beach
🔧 Tavern music: a track is only named in chat once it is really playing, the music no longer races through the whole list when a file cannot load, and if the music cannot be reached the built-in inn tunes play instead
🔧 The character screen no longer shows a scroll bar: it shrinks a little to fit shorter windows instead
✨ Website: Barbarian and Hunter class icons and guides, Dungeons, Ten professions and Trade cards, a full Professions & crafting guide, a Trading & Auction House guide, and six new screenshots
